children.title: Atomic Red Team (ART)
children.description: Small and highly portable detection tests mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK Framework.

children.title: Caldera
children.description: Automated adversary emulation system that performs post-compromise adversarial behavior within Windows Enterprise networks. It generates plans during operation using a planning system and a pre-configured adversary model based on the Adversarial Tactics, Techniques & Common Knowledge (ATT&CK™) project.

children.title: APTSimulator
children.description: Windows Batch script that uses a set of tools and output files to make a system look as if it was compromised.

children.title: Network Flight Simulator
children.description: Lightweight utility used to generate malicious network traffic and help security teams to evaluate security controls and network visibility.

children.title: RedHunt-OS
children.description: Virtual machine for adversary emulation and threat hunting.

children.title: Metta
children.description: Information security preparedness tool to do adversarial simulation.

children.title: Red Team Automation (RTA)
children.description: RTA provides a framework of scripts designed to allow blue teams to test their detection capabilities against malicious tradecraft, modeled after MITRE ATT&CK.

children.title: DumpsterFire
children.description: Modular, menu-driven, cross-platform tool for building repeatable, time-delayed, distributed security events. Easily create custom event chains for Blue Team drills and sensor / alert mapping. Red Teams can create decoy incidents, distractions, and lures to support and scale their operations.

children.title: AutoTTP
children.description: Automated Tactics Techniques & Procedures. Re-running complex sequences manually for regression tests, product evaluations, generate data for researchers.

children.title: Flare
children.description: A fully customizable, Windows-based security distribution for malware analysis, incident response, penetration testing.

children.title: Fleetdm
children.description: State of the art host monitoring platform tailored for security experts. Leveraging Facebook's battle-tested osquery project, Fleetdm delivers continuous updates, features and fast answers to big questions.

children.title: GRR Rapid Response
children.description: Incident response framework focused on remote live forensics. It consists of a python agent (client) that is installed on target systems, and a python server infrastructure that can manage and talk to the agent. Besides the included Python API client, PowerGRR provides an API client library in PowerShell working on Windows, Linux and macOS for GRR automation and scripting.

children.title: Velociraptor
children.description: Endpoint visibility and collection tool

children.title: MozDef
children.description: Automates the security incident handling process and facilitate the real-time activities of incident handlers.

children.title: Matano
children.description: Open source serverless security lake platform on AWS that lets you ingest, store, and analyze petabytes of security data into an Apache Iceberg data lake and run realtime Python detections as code.

children.title: IRIS
children.description: IRIS is a web collaborative platform for incident response analysts allowing to share investigations at a technical level.

children.title: Dissect
children.description: Dissect is a digital forensics & incident response framework and toolset that allows you to quickly access and analyse forensic artefacts from various disk and file formats, developed by Fox-IT (part of NCC Group).

children.title: Kuiper
children.description: Digital Forensics Investigation Platform

children.title: Zentral
children.description: Combines osquery's powerful endpoint inventory features with a flexible notification and action framework. This enables one to identify and react to changes on OS X and Linux clients.

children.title: CimSweep
children.description: Suite of CIM/WMI-based tools that enable the ability to perform incident response and hunting operations remotely across all versions of Windows.

children.title: Doorman
children.description: osquery fleet manager that allows remote management of osquery configurations retrieved by nodes. It takes advantage of osquery's TLS configuration, logger, and distributed read/write endpoints, to give administrators visibility across a fleet of devices with minimal overhead and intrusiveness.

children.title: nightHawk
children.description: Application built for asynchronous forensic data presentation using ElasticSearch as the backend. It's designed to ingest Redline collections.

children.title: SOC Multi-tool
children.description: A powerful and user-friendly browser extension that streamlines investigations for security professionals.

children.title: Cynative
children.description: Deep research agent for your infra - sandboxed, read-only, covers AWS, GCP, Azure, K8s, GitHub and GitLab.

children.title: VanGuard
children.description: Cross-platform incident response toolkit with 28 pre-built use cases in a single zero-install binary. Collects memory, disk, network, and cloud artifacts with automated timeline generation.

children.title: CIRTkit
children.description: CIRTKit is not just a collection of tools, but also a framework to aid in the ongoing unification of Incident Response and Forensics investigation processes.

children.title: MutableSecurity
children.description: CLI program for automating the setup, configuration, and use of cybersecurity solutions.

children.title: Bitscout
children.description: Bitscout by Vitaly Kamluk helps you build your fully-trusted customizable LiveCD/LiveUSB image to be used for remote digital forensics (or perhaps any other task of your choice). It is meant to be transparent and monitorable by the owner of the system, forensically sound, customizable and compact.

children.title: UAC
children.description: UAC (Unix-like Artifacts Collector) is a Live Response collection script for Incident Response that makes use of native binaries and tools to automate the collection of AIX, Android, ESXi, FreeBSD, Linux, macOS, NetBSD, NetScaler, OpenBSD and Solaris systems artifacts.

children.title: bulk_extractor
children.description: Computer forensics tool that scans a disk image, a file, or a directory of files and extracts useful information without parsing the file system or file system structures. Because of ignoring the file system structure, the program distinguishes itself in terms of speed and thoroughness.

children.title: Forensic Artifacts
children.description: Digital Forensics Artifact Repository

children.title: CyLR
children.description: The CyLR tool collects forensic artifacts from hosts with NTFS file systems quickly, securely and minimizes impact to the host.

children.title: ir-rescue
children.description: Windows Batch script and a Unix Bash script to comprehensively collect host forensic data during incident response.

children.title: Cold Disk Quick Response
children.description: Streamlined list of parsers to quickly analyze a forensic image file (, E01, , etc) and output nine reports.

children.title: artifactcollector
children.description: The artifactcollector project provides a software that collects forensic artifacts on systems.

children.title: Margarita Shotgun
children.description: Command line utility (that works with or without Amazon EC2 instances) to parallelize remote memory acquisition.

children.title: Acquire
children.description: Acquire is a tool to quickly gather forensic artifacts from disk images or a live system into a lightweight container. This makes Acquire an excellent tool to, among others, speedup the process of digital forensic triage. It uses Dissect to gather that information from the raw disk, if possible.

children.title: SPECTR3
children.description: Acquire, triage and investigate remote evidence via portable iSCSI readonly access

children.title: Shuffle
children.description: A general purpose security automation platform focused on accessibility.

children.title: Fast Incident Response (FIR)
children.description: Cybersecurity incident management platform designed with agility and speed in mind. It allows for easy creation, tracking, and reporting of cybersecurity incidents and is useful for CSIRTs, CERTs and SOCs alike.

children.title: DFIRTrack
children.description: Incident Response tracking application handling one or more incidents via cases and tasks with a lot of affected systems and artifacts.

children.title: Catalyst
children.description: A free SOAR system that helps to automate alert handling and incident response processes.

children.title: threat_note
children.description: Lightweight investigation notebook that allows security researchers the ability to register and retrieve indicators related to their research.

children.title: DFTimewolf
children.description: A framework for orchestrating forensic collection, processing and data export.

children.title: Sandia Cyber Omni Tracker (SCOT)
children.description: Incident Response collaboration and knowledge capture tool focused on flexibility and ease of use. Our goal is to add value to the incident response process without burdening the user.

children.title: Windows Events Attack Samples
children.description: Windows Events Attack Samples

children.title: Windows Registry Knowledge Base
children.description: Windows Registry Knowledge Base

children.title: Digital Forensics Artifact Knowledge Base
children.description: Digital Forensics Artifact Knowledge Base

children.title: Security Onion
children.description: Special Linux distro aimed at network security monitoring featuring advanced analysis tools.

children.title: CCF-VM
children.description: CyLR CDQR Forensics Virtual Machine (CCF-VM): An all-in-one solution to parsing collected data, making it easily searchable with built-in common searches, enable searching of single and multiple hosts simultaneously.

children.title: NullSec Linux
children.description: Security-focused Linux distribution with 140+ pre-installed forensic and offensive security tools, custom hardened kernel, and integrated incident response workflows.

children.title: MAGNET DumpIt
children.description: Fast memory acquisition open source tool for Linux written in Rust. Generate full memory crash dumps of Linux machines.

children.title: FastIR Collector Linux
children.description: FastIR for Linux collects different artifacts on live Linux and records the results in CSV files.

children.title: Sigma
children.description: Generic signature format for SIEM systems already containing an extensive ruleset.

children.title: Chainsaw
children.description: Chainsaw provides a powerful ‘first-response’ capability to quickly identify threats within Windows event logs.

children.title: Hayabusa
children.description: Hayabusa is a Windows event log fast forensics timeline generator and threat hunting tool created by the Yamato Security group in Japan.

children.title: LogonTracer
children.description: Tool to investigate malicious Windows logon by visualizing and analyzing Windows event log.

children.title: StreamAlert
children.description: Serverless, real-time log data analysis framework, capable of ingesting custom data sources and triggering alerts using user-defined logic.

children.title: APT Hunter
children.description: APT-Hunter is Threat Hunting tool for windows event logs.

children.title: Zircolite
children.description: A standalone and fast SIGMA-based detection tool for EVTX or JSON.

children.title: SysmonSearch
children.description: SysmonSearch makes Windows event log analysis more effective and less time consuming by aggregation of event logs.

children.title: Lorg
children.description: Tool for advanced HTTPD logfile security analysis and forensics.

children.title: AppCompatProcessor
children.description: AppCompatProcessor has been designed to extract additional value from enterprise-wide AppCompat / AmCache data beyond the classic stacking and grepping techniques.

children.title: Logdissect
children.description: CLI utility and Python API for analyzing log files and other data.

children.title: WELA
children.description: Windows Event Log Analyzer aims to be the Swiss Army knife for Windows event logs.

children.title: NullSec LogReaper
children.description: High-speed log analysis and forensics tool with multi-format parsing, pattern matching, timeline reconstruction and anomaly detection for incident response.

children.title: Volatility
children.description: Advanced memory forensics framework.

children.title: Volatility 3
children.description: The volatile memory extraction framework (successor of Volatility)

children.title: [MemProcFS] (https://github.com/ufrisk/MemProcFS
children.description: ) - MemProcFS is an easy and convenient way of viewing physical memory as files in a virtual file system.

children.title: LiME
children.description: Loadable Kernel Module (LKM), which allows the acquisition of volatile memory from Linux and Linux-based devices, formerly called DMD.

children.title: AVML
children.description: A portable volatile memory acquisition tool for Linux.

children.title: MalConfScan
children.description: MalConfScan is a Volatility plugin extracts configuration data of known malware. Volatility is an open-source memory forensics framework for incident response and malware analysis. This tool searches for malware in memory images and dumps configuration data. In addition, this tool has a function to list strings to which malicious code refers.

children.title: inVtero.net
children.description: Advanced memory analysis for Windows x64 with nested hypervisor support.

children.title: Orochi
children.description: Orochi is an open source framework for collaborative forensic memory dump analysis.

children.title: VolatilityBot
children.description: Automation tool for researchers cuts all the guesswork and manual tasks out of the binary extraction phase, or to help the investigator in the first steps of performing a memory analysis investigation.

children.title: Evolve
children.description: Web interface for the Volatility Memory Forensics Framework.

children.title: VolDiff
children.description: Malware Memory Footprint Analysis based on Volatility.

children.title: Linux Memory Grabber
children.description: Script for dumping Linux memory and creating Volatility profiles.

children.title: OSX Auditor
children.description: Free Mac OS X computer forensics tool.

children.title: OSX Collector
children.description: OSX Auditor offshoot for live response.

children.title: macOS Artifact Parsing Tool (mac_apt)
children.description: Plugin based forensics framework for quick mac triage that works on live machines, disk images or individual artifact files.

children.title: Awesome Forensics
children.description: A curated list of awesome forensic analysis tools and resources.

children.title: Didier Stevens Suite
children.description: Tool collection

children.title: List of various Security APIs
children.description: Collective list of public JSON APIs for use in security.

children.title: Awesome Event IDs
children.description: Collection of Event ID resources useful for Digital Forensics and Incident Response.

children.title: sysmon-config
children.description: Sysmon configuration file template with default high-quality event tracing

children.title: HELK
children.description: Threat Hunting platform.

children.title: sysmon-modular
children.description: A repository of sysmon configuration modules

children.title: Stenographer
children.description: Packet capture solution which aims to quickly spool all packets to disk, then provide simple, fast access to subsets of those packets. It stores as much history as it possible, managing disk usage, and deleting when disk limits are hit. It's ideal for capturing the traffic just before and during an incident, without the need explicit need to store all of the network traffic.

children.title: Kansa
children.description: Modular incident response framework in PowerShell.

children.title: Hindsight
children.description: Internet history forensics for Google Chrome/Chromium.

children.title: Raccine
children.description: A Simple Ransomware Protection

children.title: Munin
children.description: Online hash checker for VirusTotal and other services.

children.title: Diffy
children.description: DFIR tool developed by Netflix's SIRT that allows an investigator to quickly scope a compromise across cloud instances (Linux instances on AWS, currently) during an incident and efficiently triaging those instances for followup actions by showing differences against a baseline.

children.title: MFT Browser
children.description: MFT directory tree reconstruction & record info.

children.title: Hostintel
children.description: Pull intelligence per host.

children.title: rastrea2r
children.description: Allows one to scan disks and memory for IOCs using YARA on Windows, Linux and OS X.

children.title: imagemounter
children.description: Command line utility and Python package to ease the (un)mounting of forensic disk images.

children.title: Fileintel
children.description: Pull intelligence per file hash.

children.title: PowerSponse
children.description: PowerSponse is a PowerShell module focused on targeted containment and remediation during security incident response.

children.title: traceroute-circl
children.description: Extended traceroute to support the activities of CSIRT (or CERT) operators. Usually CSIRT team have to handle incidents based on IP addresses received. Created by Computer Emergency Response Center Luxembourg.

children.title: PyaraScanner
children.description: Very simple multi-threaded many-rules to many-files YARA scanning Python script for malware zoos and IR.

children.title: domfind
children.description: Python DNS crawler for finding identical domain names under different TLDs.

children.title: ThreatHunter-Playbook
children.description: Playbook to aid the development of techniques and hypothesis for hunting campaigns.

children.title: IRM
children.description: Incident Response Methodologies by CERT Societe Generale.

children.title: AWS Incident Response Runbook Samples
children.description: AWS IR Runbook Samples meant to be customized per each entity using them. The three samples are: "DoS or DDoS attack", "credential leakage", and "unintended access to an Amazon S3 bucket".

children.title: PagerDuty Incident Response Documentation
children.description: Documents that describe parts of the PagerDuty Incident Response process. It provides information not only on preparing for an incident, but also what to do during and after. Source is available on GitHub.

children.title: Counteractive Playbooks
children.description: Counteractive PLaybooks collection.

children.title: Phantom Community Playbooks
children.description: Phantom Community Playbooks for Splunk but also customizable for other use.

children.title: GuardSIght Playbook Battle Cards
children.description: A collection of Cyber Incident Response Playbook Battle Cards

children.title: Ghidra
children.description: Software Reverse Engineering Framework.

children.title: Radare2
children.description: Reverse engineering framework and command-line toolset.

children.title: Cutter
children.description: Free and Open Source Reverse Engineering Platform powered by rizin.

children.title: CAPA
children.description: detects capabilities in executable files. You run it against a PE, ELF, .NET module, or shellcode file and it tells you what it thinks the program can do.

children.title: Cuckoo
children.description: Open Source Highly configurable sandboxing tool.

children.title: Rizin
children.description: UNIX-like reverse engineering framework and command-line toolset

children.title: CAPEv2
children.description: Malware Configuration And Payload Extraction.

children.title: Viper
children.description: Python based binary analysis and management framework, that works well with Cuckoo and YARA.

children.title: StringSifter
children.description: A machine learning tool that ranks strings based on their relevance for malware analysis.

children.title: Cuckoo-modified
children.description: Heavily modified Cuckoo fork developed by community.

children.title: Mastiff
children.description: Static analysis framework that automates the process of extracting key characteristics from a number of different file formats.

children.title: Visualize_Logs
children.description: Open source visualization library and command line tools for logs (Cuckoo, Procmon, more to come).

children.title: Cuckoo-modified-api
children.description: Python library to control a cuckoo-modified sandbox.

children.title: LOKI
children.description: Free IR scanner for scanning endpoint with yara rules and other indicators(IOCs).

children.title: Fenrir
children.description: Simple IOC scanner. It allows scanning any Linux/Unix/OSX system for IOCs in plain bash. Created by the creators of THOR and LOKI.

children.title: Spyre
children.description: Simple YARA-based IOC scanner written in Go

children.title: Timesketch
children.description: Open source tool for collaborative forensic timeline analysis.

children.title: Plaso
children.description: a Python-based backend engine for the tool log2timeline.

children.title: Aurora Incident Response
children.description: Platform developed to build easily a detailed timeline of an incident.

children.title: Morgue
children.description: PHP Web app by Etsy for managing postmortems.

children.title: LOKI
children.description: Free IR scanner for scanning endpoint with yara rules and other indicators(IOCs).

children.title: Fibratus
children.description: Tool for exploration and tracing of the Windows kernel.

children.title: PowerForensics
children.description: Live disk forensics platform, using PowerShell.

children.title: RegRipper
children.description: Open source tool, written in Perl, for extracting/parsing information (keys, values, data) from the Registry and presenting it for analysis.

children.title: FastIR Collector
children.description: Tool that collects different artifacts on live Windows systems and records the results in csv files. With the analyses of these artifacts, an early compromise can be detected.

children.title: PSRecon
children.description: PSRecon gathers data from a remote Windows host using PowerShell (v2 or later), organizes the data into folders, hashes all extracted data, hashes PowerShell and various system properties, and sends the data off to the security team. The data can be pushed to a share, sent over email, or retained locally.

children.title: MEERKAT
children.description: PowerShell-based triage and threat hunting for Windows.

children.title: DFIR ORC
children.description: DFIR ORC is a collection of specialized tools dedicated to reliably parse and collect critical artifacts such as the MFT, registry hives or event logs. DFIR ORC collects data, but does not analyze it: it is not meant to triage machines. It provides a forensically relevant snapshot of machines running Microsoft Windows. The code can be found on GitHub.

children.title: Hoarder
children.description: Collecting the most valuable artifacts for forensics or incident response investigations.

children.title: AChoir
children.description: Framework/scripting tool to standardize and simplify the process of scripting live acquisition utilities for Windows.

children.title: Invoke-LiveResponse
children.description: Invoke-LiveResponse is a live response tool for targeted collection.

children.title: IRTriage
children.description: Incident Response Triage - Windows Evidence Collection for Forensic Analysis.

children.title: Panorama
children.description: Fast incident overview on live Windows systems.
